draft_en.subject: Your 12-fibre + 12-copper managed PoE switch - the $150 quote from ISAF still stands
draft_en.body:
Hi Ahmet,

We met at ISAF 2025 in Istanbul last October - this picks up what we discussed at the booth.

You asked about a managed PoE switch with 12 fibre + 12 copper ports and we quoted $150 USD EXW at the booth - that price still stands (MOQ 1; CE/RoHS; neutral packaging or your label). For the everyday camera jobs around Çumra, the 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 SFP L2+ managed unit is $84.1 USD EXW.

One question: has the project started - and how many units does it need?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
